tag: A knight. A robot. A very bad rug.
intro: Lord Rugpull kidnapped Mintje and fled through 5 worlds. Raid the ice, the Meme Factory, the Moon Mine, Candle Canyon and the Rug Tower, and bring her home.
free: Free. No wallet, no sign-up. Coins in the game are only collectibles.
jpD: The ice knight. Sword, 5 hearts, heavy armour.
boltD: The robot. Zap blaster, 4 hearts, a bit faster.
subInfo: Only letters, numbers and _ (like an X @name). Shown publicly on the leaderboard.
lbNote: Names are typed by players and not checked. Scores are for fun only, no prizes.
rot: Tip: turn your phone sideways for a bigger screen.
kJump: Jump (press again in the air for a double jump)
kAtk: Sword (Jean-Phil) or zap (Bolt). Breaks ice and crates.
kDash: Dash: you can't be hit while dashing
kPad: Controller: stick, A jump, X attack, B dash, Start pause
pups: Power-ups: ♥ heart, 💎 Diamond Guard (blocks one hit), 🚀 Moon Boots (higher jumps), 🐂 Bull Run (faster). Jump on enemies to stomp them.
cP: $MAIGA is Jean-Phil's satirical meme coin on Solana. The game never touches a wallet.
warn: Entertainment only. Meme coins can lose all their value. No price or profit promises. Never share your seed phrase. NFA, DYOR.
